# Patient RX System v2.0.64

## Production Dashboard Trend Schema Fallback

- Expanded the dashboard trend schema guard so the chart API waits for the full `DailySnapshots` trend column set before querying.
- Prevented production dashboard charts from throwing when the database is missing `patientsWithNoRx` or other newer trend columns.
- Kept the release focused on production graph stability and schema compatibility.

## Database Impact

- No new schema changes are introduced by this release.
- This update only changes how the dashboard handles older production databases.

## Validation

- JavaScript syntax checks passed for the modified snapshot service, dashboard controller, and dashboard UI script.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- A fresh production build and update zip will be generated for version `2.0.64`.
